title: PongLens
tagline: Keep every student, lesson and match in one place.

delivery.instructions: Warm and plain spoken, like a coach explaining something useful to another coach. Unhurried and even. Nothing is sold and nothing is hurried. No rising lift at the end of sentences.

lines.text: PongLens gives a table tennis coach one place to keep students, lessons and matches together.

lines.label: Your students
lines.text: Add every student to one roster. They do not need a PongLens account to start.

lines.label: Your students
lines.text: Open a student to see their lesson entries and the matches they have shared.

lines.label: Connect them
lines.text: When they are ready, send a private invite. It connects their account to the student you already know.

lines.label: Keep the lesson
lines.text: After a session, write what you worked on, what to fix and what comes next.

lines.label: Keep the lesson
lines.text: PongLens can turn rough notes into clear points, and keeps the original transcript with them.

lines.label: Record the lesson
lines.text: Lesson recording is on iPhone. Leave the phone near the table and PongLens prepares the entry afterwards. Video recording is coming soon.

lines.label: Share it
lines.text: An entry stays private until you share it.

lines.label: Share it
lines.text: Once shared, it appears in your student's PongLens journal. You can also send it as a link.

lines.label: Their matches
lines.text: The matches a student shares sit beside their lesson entries, ready to watch point by point.

lines.label: Paid reviews
lines.text: If you also sell remote match reviews, choose what each review covers, what it costs and how long you need.
PongLens. Keep every student, lesson and match in one place.
